name: claude-badge help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:claude-badge. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Show on the banner
entries.text: Puts this badge on the banner, or takes it off. Hiding the console badge also stops its test when the console loads.

entries.title: Icons only
entries.text: Shows just the icon, without the word. The colour still shows the state. Each badge has its own switch.

entries.title: Badges
entries.text: Settings for the Claude, VPS, axHub, AmberX, usage, disk, CPU and memory badges on the banner.

entries.title: Server health
entries.text: Disk, CPU load, memory and swap on the VPS, each with a meter and its warn and red lines. The Disk, CPU and Mem badges open it; so does the VPS badge.

entries.title: Warn at %
entries.text: From this percent the badge turns amber. Saved on the server, so it holds for every device.

entries.title: Red at %
entries.text: From this percent the badge turns red. For the disk, passing it also raises a console alert that reaches AmberX.

entries.title: Ping now
entries.text: Pings the VPS again. Green if it answers, red if it doesn't.
